section.content: 一种开关半导体集成电路具有控制高频信号通过的开关FET，使开关FET在通-断操作间切换。开关半导体集成电路包含使用反相器电路的逻辑控制部分，它根据外部施加的控制信号来产生开关信号，反相器电路使用结型FET，开关FET的栅极经栅极电阻器连接至反相器电路的输出端，此输出端又与耦合部分高频信号的耦合电容器相连。耦合的高频信号被结型FET的栅与漏间的等效二极管整流而叠加在施于开关FET栅极的DC电压上。

A switch semiconductor integrated circuit having a switch FET for controlling passage of a high-frequency signal so that the switch FET is switched between on-operation and off-operation. The switch semiconductor integrated circuit includes a logic control section using of an inverter circuit which generates the switching signal in accordance with a control signal applied from outside, the inverter circuit uses a junction-type FET the gate of the switch FET is connected to an output end of the inverter circuit via a gate resistor, and the output end is connected to a coupling capacitor which couples a part of the high-frequency signal. The coupled high-frequency signal is rectified by an equivalent diode between the gate and drain of the junction-type FET, and is superposed onto a DC voltage applied to the gate of the switch FET.

The switching semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to the semiconductor switch circuit of switch high-frequency signal, especially improved the semiconductor switch circuit of operating characteristic.

Background technology

Use the switching semiconductor integrated circuit in equipment such as the mini phone of handling high-frequency signal, mobile radio communication equipment, field effect transistor M ESFET (metal-semiconductor field effect transistor), the HEMT (High Electron Mobility Transistor) etc. that sort circuit uses the GaAs compound semiconductor materials to make carry out the switch of high-frequency signal.

Because so pocket mobile communication terminal device powered battery, need particularly under low pressure can the switch high-frequency signal the switching semiconductor integrated circuit.As a kind of like this switching semiconductor integrated circuit, open and extensively know be, for example, SPDT (single-pole double throw) switching circuit, it is designed to comprise inverter circuit and comes (for example to carry out switch with a control signal, disclose 164772/2002, the 4 page referring to Japanese unexamined patent, Fig. 1).

Fig. 7 represents a kind of so conventional SPDT switching circuit.Below, with reference to Fig. 7 this custom circuit is described.

With reference to Fig. 7, P1, P2 and P3 representation signal end; Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Q5 represent FET; S1 representative control bias effect end; R1, R2, R3, R4, R5 and R6 represent resistor; C1, C2 and C3 representative cut off the capacitor of DC electric current; And the power supply of driving voltage Vdd is supplied with in the V1 representative.

Inverter circuit in Fig. 7 exemplary circuit is the DCFL that generally knows (straight coupling FET logic), and wherein enhancement mode FET is as Q3, the Q4 and the Q5 that form inverter circuit, depletion type FET as switch Q1 and Q2 to reduce the conduction loss of ON state.

In this configuration, when high level voltage puts on, for example, during control bias effect end S1, FETQ3 becomes ON state and makes the grid of switch FETQ1 get ground potential GND.Simultaneously, because another FETQ4 that links to each other with control bias effect end S1 becomes ON state, the grid of FETQ5 is also got the GND current potential.As a result, enhancement mode FETQ5 becomes OFF state and makes supply voltage Vdd be added to the grid of switch FETQ2 through loading resistor R6 by power supply V1.In addition, the drain electrode of switch FETQ1, Q2 and source electrode are through resistor R 3 also power taking source voltage Vdd.

Because such voltage puts on switching circuit, between grid-leakages of switch FETQ2 and the voltage difference between grid-source will be zero, thereby make the drain electrode of switch FETQ2 and source electrode electric connection each other.On the other hand, supply voltage Vdd is by between the grid-leakage that oppositely is applied to switch FETQ1 of schottky junction and between grid-source, thus make the drain electrode of switch FETQ1 and source electrode each other electricity turn-off.As a result, signal end P1 is electrically connected with signal end P3 high-frequency signal can be passed through, and signal end P1 and signal end P2 are then electric each other to be cut off.

On the other hand, when low level voltage puts on bias voltage control action end S1, the grid voltage of switch FETQ1 is got Vdd, the grid voltage of switch FETQ2 is got the GND current potential, this just makes signal end P1 and signal end P2 be electrically connected to each other high-frequency signal can be passed through, and signal end P1 and signal end P3 electricity shutoff each other, the situation when this puts on control bias effect end S1 with aforesaid high level voltage is opposite.

In a kind of like this switching semiconductor integrated circuit, the switching semiconductor integrated circuit treatable maximum power depend on the FET of OFF state usually.For example, high-frequency signal maximum power open and that extensively know is generally following formula and (for example provides, see " Monolithic microwaveIntegrated Circuit (MMIC) ", MaSSayoshi AIKAWA and four others, Electronic information Communicatin Society (a corporate juridicalperson), Jan.25,1997).

Pmax＝2{n(Vbias-Vp)} 2/Z0

Here, the switch FET number of n representative series connection; The pinch-off voltage of Vp representation switch FET; The Vbias representative puts on the bias voltage of OFF state switch FET gate terminal; And Z 0The characteristic impedance of representative system.Will understand that according to this formula,, can increase the switch FET number of series connection, maybe can do the pinch-off voltage of switch FET lower, perhaps also can improve bias voltage in order to increase the maximum power Pmax of switching semiconductor integrated circuit.

Yet the above-mentioned ordinary tap semiconductor integrated circuit that is used for pocket terminal equipment has a problem, promptly increases switch FET number and can cause so-called chip area increase, causes cost to rise.In addition, if the pinch-off voltage of switch FET is done lowlyer, can cause the increase of switch FET ON resistance, thereby cause the problem that conduction loss worsens, this is switch FET one of most important characteristic when becoming ON state.In addition, in the used switching semiconductor integrated circuit of pocket terminal equipment, a problem is arranged,, can not improve the bias voltage of switch FET simply promptly owing to aforesaid low-voltage driving requirement.

Therefore, as the means that improve the FET bias voltage, proposed a kind ofly, for example, Japanese unexamined patent discloses disclosed technology No. 112314/1999.Promptly, according to the method, the dc voltage generation circuit that employing comprises diode, resistor and capacitor produces a dc voltage by high-frequency signal, and by higher in driving voltage and the dc voltage according to a switch high-frequency signal timing generation switch control voltage, thereby bias voltage is raise.

Yet according to this technology, complicated circuit arrangement has caused the problem that increases chip area and make the cost rising owing to the increase component number.

Summary of the invention

In view of the foregoing made the present invention, its objective is provides a kind of switching semiconductor integrated circuit, and it can under low pressure drive, but and the more powerful high-frequency signal of the conventional situation of on-off ratio.

Another object of the present invention provides a kind of switching semiconductor integrated circuit, and it can improve high frequency characteristics and distortion performance.

According to the present invention, provide a kind of switching semiconductor integrated circuit that switch FET arranged to control the conducting of high-frequency signal, make switch FET by the switching signal that puts on its grid ON operation with close operation room and switch,

Wherein the switching semiconductor integrated circuit comprises the logic control part of using inverter circuit, and it produces switching signal according to the control signal that the outside applies,

Inverter circuit uses junction type FET, and the ohmic load that connects power supply is attached thereto,

The grid of switch FET links to each other with the output of inverter circuit through grid resistor, this output links to each other with the coupling capacitor of coupling unit high-frequency signal, thereby make coupled high-frequency signal by the equivalent diode rectification between junction type FET grid and leakage, and be superimposed upon on the dc voltage that puts on switch FET grid.

According to this configuration, when the junction type FET of inverter circuit becomes OFF state, switch FET becomes ON state, at this moment, be present in equivalent diode rectification between OFF state junction type FET grid and leakage by the part high-frequency signal of coupling capacitor coupling, and be superimposed upon on the dc voltage that imposes on switch FET grid, thereby the more powerful high-frequency signal of the conventional situation of energy on-off ratio, even under low driving voltage.

Embodiment

Below, with reference to Fig. 1-6 embodiments of the present invention are described.

Here, be noted that the material, configuration and other contents that describe below all can not limit the present invention, can carry out various modifications, as long as keep within the scope of the invention.

First exemplary circuit of embodiment of the present invention at first, is described with reference to Fig. 1.

In this first exemplary circuit, switching semiconductor integrated circuit SC1 can divide for by switch sections 101 and logic control part 102 and form roughly.

Switch sections 101 comprises the first and second switch FET1,2 (being expressed as " Q1 " and " Q2 " in Fig. 1 respectively), the first and second switch FET1,2 work, as hereinafter described, be to come switch, thereby change the connection status (hereinafter will describe in detail) of first to the 3rd signal end 41,42,43 (in Fig. 1, being expressed as " P1 ", " P2 ", " P3 " respectively) by switching voltage from logic control part 102.

Logic control part 102 is come the first and second switch FET1 of control switch part 101,2 work (hereinafter will describe in detail) according to the control signal output switch control signal that is applied to signal input end 45 (being expressed as " S1 " among Fig. 1) from the outside.

Below, form describing a concrete circuit.

At first, switch sections 101 comprises the first and second switch FET1,2 as main element, and all adopts depletion mode fet in the embodiments of the present invention.

The drain electrode of the first switch FET1 (or source electrode) links to each other with secondary signal end 42 through first capacitor 11 (being expressed as " C1 " in Fig. 1), and the source electrode of the first switch FET1 (or drain electrode) links to each other with first signal end through the 3rd capacitor 13 (being expressed as " C3 " in Fig. 1) together with the drain electrode (or source electrode) of second switch FET2.In addition, the source electrode of the first switch FET1 (or drain electrode) links to each other with power supply 51 (being expressed as " V1 " in Fig. 1) through the 3rd resistor 23 (being expressed as " R3 " in Fig. 1) together with the drain electrode (or source electrode) of second switch FET2.

And the source electrode of second switch FET2 (or drain electrode) links to each other with the 3rd signal end 43 through second capacitor 12 (being expressed as " C2 " in Fig. 1).

Moreover, the grid of the first switch FET1 links to each other through the drain electrode (or source electrode) of first resistor 21 (being expressed as " R1 " in Fig. 1) with the 3rd switch FET3 (being expressed as " Q3 " in Fig. 1), and the grid of second switch FET2 links to each other through the drain electrode (or source electrode) of second resistor 22 (being expressed as " R2 " in Fig. 1) with the 5th FET5 (being expressed as " Q5 " in Fig. 1), and the 5th FET5 also is one of element of the logic control part 102 described later.

In addition, the drain electrode of the first switch FET1 links to each other with the drain electrode of the 3rd FET3 through the 4th capacitor 14 (being expressed as " C4 " in Fig. 1), and the drain electrode of second switch FET2 links to each other with the drain electrode of the 5th FET5 through the 5th capacitor 15 (being expressed as " C5 " in Fig. 1).

On the other hand, logic control part 102 comprises the 3rd to the 5th FET3-5 as main element, and all adopts enhancement mode field effect transistor in embodiments of the present invention, and each all forms the ohmic load inverter circuit.

Particularly, at first, third and fourth FET3,4 grid link to each other with signal input end 45.In addition, third and fourth FET3,4 source electrode (or drain electrode) be ground connection all, and the drain electrode of the 3rd FET3 (or source electrode), the output of inverter circuit just, link to each other with power supply 51 through the 4th resistor 24 (in Fig. 1, being expressed as " R4 "), and the drain electrode of the 4th FET4 (or source electrode) (being expressed as " Q4 " in Fig. 1) also links to each other with power supply 51 through the 5th resistor 25 (being expressed as " R5 " in Fig. 1).

Moreover the grid of the 5th FET5 links to each other with the drain electrode (or source electrode) of the 4th FET4.In addition, the drain electrode of the 5th FET5 (or source electrode), just the output of inverter circuit links to each other with power supply 51 through the 6th resistor 26 (being expressed as " R6 " in Fig. 1), and the source electrode of the 5th FET5 (or drain electrode) ground connection.

Here, in embodiments of the present invention, in above-mentioned configuration, drain to the line between first resistor 21 and the 4th capacitor 14 tie points from the 3rd FET3, and from drain electrode to the second resistor 22 of the 5th FET5 and the line between the 5th capacitor 15 tie points, for simplicity, all will be called " switch signal line ".

Below, will the working condition of aforementioned arrangements be described.

At first, the working condition when describing voltage corresponding to the high logic value level and put on signal input end 45.For this situation, the effect of this voltage makes third and fourth FET3,4 become ON state (conducting attitude).

Because the 3rd FET3 conducting, the grid of the first switch FET1 is current potential closely.For this reason, the first switch FET1 becomes OFF state (the non-attitude that conducts).

On the other hand, because the 4th FET4 conducting, the 5th FET5 becomes OFF state (the non-attitude that conducts), and feasible voltage near supply voltage Vdd puts on the grid of second switch FET2 through the 6th resistor 26 and second resistor 22, thereby makes second switch FET2 become ON state.

As a result, high-frequency signal just can pass through at first signal end 41 and 43 of the 3rd signal ends, and at 42 at first signal end 41 and secondary signal end, because of the first switch FET1 is that OFF state is turned off the conducting of high-frequency signal.Here, the part high-frequency signal that puts on first signal end 41 or the 3rd signal end 43 can leak to switch signal line because of the coupling of the 5th capacitor 15.

Here, owing to form the resistance value of the 4th to the 6th resistor 24-26 of inverter load resistance, elect ten to tens K Ω as for reducing current drain, switch signal line will have big impedance.For this reason, leak on the supply voltage Vdd that is superimposed upon dc voltage to the high-frequency signal of switch signal line through the 5th capacitor 15.

In addition, because the 5th FET5 has the junction gate structure, the part equivalence between its grid and leakage is a diode, and its is leaked the high-frequency signal of coming through the 5th capacitor 15 and places reverse bias condition.For this reason, if high-frequency signal be on the occasion of during, the voltage of switch signal line will rise, as long as voltage remains in the aforementioned equivalent diode puncture voltage scope.

On the other hand, if high-frequency signal is in during the negative value, this diode will be by open-minded, promptly, when supply voltage Vdd when being superimposed upon high-frequency signal sum on this supply voltage Vdd and surpassing the built-in voltage Vbi of this equivalent diode, conduct each other between the grid of the 5th FET5 and leakage.Then, be ON state owing to connect the 4th FET4 of the 5th FET5 grid, the grid of the 5th FET5 is current potential closely, thereby the voltage of switch signal line is fixed as-Vbi.

As a result, commutating voltage waveform shown in Figure 4 will appear on the switch signal line that links to each other with the second switch FET2 grid of ON state.The dc voltage component of this commutating voltage will be understood naturally by Fig. 4, for being higher than the state of supply voltage Vdd.Therefore, the dc voltage that is higher than supply voltage will put on the switch FET grid of ON state, that is, second switch FET2 belongs to this situation.

For this reason, the grid voltage of the second switch FET2 of ON state will be higher than leakage/source voltage Vdd, if and the voltage difference of Vdd surpasses between switch FET grid that equivalence is present in ON state and leakage and the built-in voltage Vbi of diode between grid and source therewith, these equivalent diodes will become ON state.Therefore, deduct between the drain electrode and source electrode that the resulting voltage of built-in voltage Vbi will appear at second switch FET2 from the voltage of the second switch FET2 grid that puts on ON state.

On the other hand, the drain voltage of the first switch FET1 of OFF state and source voltage will also raise from supply voltage Vdd because the drain voltage of the first switch FET1 of OFF state has the voltage identical with the second switch FET2 of ON state with source voltage this moment.

In addition, as previously mentioned, the drain voltage of the first switch FET1 of OFF state is fixed as earth potential.For this reason, though put on the first switch FET1 grid of OFF state and leak between and the reverse biased between grid and source be generally supply voltage Vdd because according to the above-mentioned operative scenario of the switching semiconductor integrated circuit of embodiment of the present invention, can apply the bias voltage that is higher than Vdd.As a result, OFF state FET, the first switch FET1 promptly belongs to this situation, and accessible maximum power increases, and therefore generally speaking the switching semiconductor integrated circuit can the bigger signal of switch.

Along with input power increases this will be more obvious, when the input large-signal, need not improve supply voltage and just can make system be in the state that is equivalent to the rising supply voltage, thereby switching semiconductor integrated circuit a kind of even switch high-power high-frequency signal under low pressure is provided.

Fig. 5 is illustrated in the practical measuring examples according to OFF state switch FET leakage/source voltage terminal in the switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.Below, Fig. 5 will be described.At first, transverse axis is represented input power in Fig. 5, and (or source) terminal voltage is leaked in longitudinal axis representative.

At first, in custom circuit, no matter how input power changes, and drain terminal voltage keeps steady state value Vdd.On the other hand, can confirm that in switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention, the voltage that appears at drain terminal in the scope of low input power is supply voltage by Fig. 5; Yet when input power increased again, the dc voltage that appears at drain terminal began at the 30dBm place to rise, and when input power further increased, drain terminal voltage will raise with the increase of input power.

Secondly, Fig. 6 is illustrated in the practical measuring examples of conduction loss and input power in the switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.Below, Fig. 6 will be described.At first, in Fig. 6, transverse axis is represented input power, and the longitudinal axis is represented conduction loss.In addition, in Fig. 6, dotted line is represented the practical measuring examples of custom circuit, and solid line is represented the practical measuring examples of switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention.

Here, custom circuit is not except having in Fig. 1 example outside the capacitor corresponding to the 4th and the 5th capacitor 14,15, and used FET number, the pinch-off voltage of FET and supply voltage and circuit of the present invention are under the same condition.

Practical measuring examples can be confirmed thus, and for the situation of custom circuit, when input power reached 33dBm, conduction loss began to worsen, and after this, conduction loss will the index rising (seeing characteristic curve shown in the dotted line among Fig. 6) with the increase of input power.

In contrast, can confirm,,,, input power do not worsen (seeing characteristic curve shown in Fig. 6 solid line) along with increasing conduction loss although under the operating voltage identical with custom circuit for the situation of switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention yet.

Like this, for the situation of switching semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention, can improve the power switch ability greatly and do not improve supply voltage.In addition, the capacitor that couples high frequency signals is used corresponding to the capacitor shown in Fig. 1 14,15, has 1pF or littler low capacity just enough usually, thereby can obtain above-mentioned operating characteristic and do not increase the scale or the chip size of integrated circuit.

Here, can be by regulating the input power that grid voltage begins to rise with the value of the 4th and the 5th capacitor 14,15 of high-frequency signal line coupling.In addition, in example shown in Figure 1, an end of the 4th capacitor 14 is connected to secondary signal end 42 sides, and an end of the 5th capacitor 15 is connected to the 3rd signal end 43 sides; Yet,, also can obtain similar function and effect even they all are connected to first signal end, 41 sides.

According to such configuration, the unnecessary high-frequency signal that produces on switch signal line will be by 16,17 eliminations of the 6th and the 7th capacitor, and the high-frequency signal voltage component that is superimposed upon on the switch signal line can decide by suitably choosing the ratio of the 6th and the 7th capacitor 16,17 with the 4th and the 5th capacitor 14,15 of input switch semiconductor integrated circuit SC2 that high-frequency signal is coupled.

Particularly, at first, the 7th resistor 27 (being expressed as " R7 " in Fig. 3) is connected between the tie point of first signal input end 45 and first resistor 21 and the 4th capacitor C4, thereby makes the switching signal of delivering to first signal input end 45 from the outer logic circuit (not shown) put on the grid of the first switch FET1 through the 7th resistor 27 and first resistor 21.In addition, first diode 31 (in Fig. 3, being expressed as " D1 ") be connected and the tie point of first resistor 21 and the 4th capacitor C4 between, make the plus earth of first diode 31 and its negative electrode links to each other with the tie point of first resistor 21 and the 4th capacitor C4.Here, to have the resistance of ten K Ω to tens K Ω be suitable to the 7th resistor 27.

Simultaneously, the 8th resistor 28 (being expressed as " R8 " in Fig. 3) is connected between the tie point of second signal input end 46 and second resistor 22 and the 5th capacitor 15, thereby makes the switching signal of delivering to second signal input end 46 from outer logic circuit put on the grid of second switch FET 2 through the 8th resistor 28 and second resistor 22.In addition, second diode 32 (in Fig. 3, being expressed as " D2 ") be connected and the tie point of second resistor 22 and the 5th capacitor 15 between, make the plus earth of second diode 32 and its negative electrode links to each other with the tie point of second resistor 22 and the 5th capacitor 15.Here, to have the resistance of ten K Ω to tens K Ω be suitable to the 8th resistor 28.

In addition, an end of the 3rd resistor 23 is connected to the drain tie point of (or source electrode) of the first switch FET1 source electrode (or drain electrode) and second switch FET2 in the mode identical with Fig. 1 example, and its other end links to each other with power supply 51.

According to such configuration, reciprocal logical signal puts on first signal input end 45 and second signal input end 46 respectively from the outer logic circuit (not shown).

Promptly, for example supply with first signal input end 45 voltages identical and second signal input end 46 when placing earth potential when power supply 51 with supply voltage Vdd, the grid of the first switch FET1 and leak between and the voltage difference between grid and source will be zero, making the switch FET1 that wins is ON state, thereby can pass through high-frequency signal between its leakage and source.On the other hand, second switch FET2 is an OFF state, though because the voltage difference between its leakage and source is an earth potential for the Vdd grid.

If in this state, high-frequency signal is imported first signal end 41 or secondary signal end 42, and the part high-frequency signal leaks to the line (tie point) between first resistor 21 and the 7th resistor 27 because of the coupling of the 4th capacitor 14.Because the 7th resistor 27 has high resistance, the part high-frequency signal that bleeds will superpose each other with the dc voltage as switching signal of first signal input end, 45 inputs from the outside; Yet this part high-frequency signal will be fixed as the built-in voltage-Vbi of diode by first diode 31 during its negative value.As a result, because its principle is to similar with reference to the described person of the example of Fig. 1, when large-signal was imported this switching semiconductor integrated circuit SC3, the switching voltage of the switch FET of OFF state can raise, thereby can be in switch large-signal under the low driving voltage.

Having enumerated SPDT (single-pole double throw) switch is in embodiments of the present invention described as an example; Yet the present invention also can be used for general switching semiconductor integrated circuit equally, and its switching circuit has the switch FET of ON state and the switch FET of OFF state, for example DPDT (dpdt double-pole double-throw (DPDT)) switch.

As mentioned above, the present invention is by providing a kind of configuration, wherein a part of input high-frequency signal is by rectification and be superimposed upon on the ON state switch FET grid voltage by high-frequency signal, but produces the just conventional situation of the on-off ratio effect of high-power high-frequency signal more of driving voltage that do not raise.

In addition, but because the more powerful high-frequency signal of the conventional situation of on-off ratio, the present invention can help to provide a kind of switching semiconductor integrated circuit that has improved high frequency characteristics and distortion performance.
